title: It's Thyme | KEY.co
description_expanded: Set in the peaceful coastal community of Seagrove Beach along scenic 30A, this expansive retreat offers a perfect blend of relaxation, entertainment, and coastal charm just steps from the beach. Sun-filled interiors create an airy and welcoming atmosphere, with beautifully designed living spaces that invite gatherings with family and friends. The chef’s kitchen features high-end appliances, custom cabinetry, and generous seating, flowing effortlessly into the dining and living areas for memorable meals and conversations. Step outside to a private pool deck complete with a tranquil water feature, summer kitchen, and grilling station—ideal for relaxed afternoons and sunset dinners in the warm Gulf breeze.

Features: Outdoor kitchen Outdoor grill Pool Heated pool Garden
Guests assume all risk for use of pools
